heading: What the agent has learned about you
intro: Notes the teach agent keeps about how you learn, across every mission. They're sent with every lesson it writes, so a wrong one is worth removing.
empty: Nothing yet. The agent writes here as it teaches you — there's no questionnaire, because what people predict about how they learn is usually wrong.
supersededBy: The agent later replaced this with "{slug}". Both are kept so you can see what changed.
